inspiration: One record per creature: a huge four-legged body, two wings, a burning bite, a scale drop and a permanent-effect set in one block. Ref data_free/game_config/creatures.txt lines 1294-1330.
Harvest-to-unlock: a dropped body part grants a named breath ability. Loot as ability with a clear reward moment. Ref creatures.txt lines 1315 and 1206.
Keeper look ladder: view upgrades at every five tech levels, four steps. Ref creatures.txt line 9 and tiles.txt lines 14-22.
Symbol and colour fallback per view id (ASCII glyph plus colour) for small-screen readability. Ref tiles.txt line 277.
Additive flipbook effects: flames, sparks, flashes, teleport and missile cores as 4x4, 4x2 and 2x2 sheets with additive blend. Ref fx_texture_factory.cpp lines 29 and 54 (sheets not in box).
Body material as an immunity set: undead flesh is sunlight-vulnerable and immune to poison, plague and bleeding. Ref data_free/game_config/body_materials.txt (UNDEAD_FLESH block).

briefs.label: Ember wyrm
briefs.why: a huge four-legged silhouette with wings reads as a boss at 375 wide; the burning bite is a clear signature
briefs.keep: four-legged huge body, two wing parts, harvest that unlocks a breath ability
briefs.change: Recreate as a distinct original, never a copy: crested horned head, teal and bronze palette, folded wings, cold breath instead of fire

briefs.label: Warden rank ladder
briefs.why: a visible rank change every few levels reads at a glance
briefs.keep: four stepped looks at fixed intervals
briefs.change: Recreate as a distinct original, never a copy: each step adds a crest or pauldron ornament rather than only a recolour

briefs.label: Flame flipbook
briefs.why: a 4x4 additive flipbook reads as fire without per-frame art
briefs.keep: additive blend and a 4x4 frame grid
briefs.change: Recreate as a distinct original, never a copy: cooler ember with a smoke sheet and fewer frames
briefs.ref: fx_texture_factory.cpp lines 29 and 54 (sheets not in box)
